title: cobolwork build policy
description: Which findings stop a build, which run-time checks the compiler must generate, and what an incomplete scan means. docs/spec/build-gate.md section 4. lib/policy.mjs validates the same shape and also refuses a rule id cobolwork does not declare.

block.description: A finding at or above this tier blocks. Default high.

always.description: In ratchet mode, a finding at or above this tier blocks whether or not the change introduced it. Default crit.

classes.description: A finding in one of these consequence classes blocks at any tier. Default both.

rules.description: Per rule id: block whatever its tier, or warn whatever its tier or class.

coverage.description: Incomplete coverage makes the build undecided (block) or is reported (warn). Default block.

options.description: A build without a required run-time check fails, and options nothing declares make it undecided (block); or both are reported and the build passes relaxed (warn). An option forbid names, and a check the change removes, fail either way. Default warn.

waivers.description: A waiver written with an expiry further off than maxDays covers nothing. Default 180.

checks.description: The run-time checks every program must be compiled with. Default subscript and reference-modification.

forbid.description: Options a build must not pass, beyond those that turn a required check off.
